header.name: ASPRS LAS 1.0 Public Header Block (Sec. 2.2) -- version, identifiers, creation date, scale/offset, bounds, points-by-return, plus the whole-document set-snapshot/no-mutation surface. The shared reader/writer for the whole file lives here; the other two regions reuse it (family-module pattern) rather than duplicating it.

vlr.name: ASPRS LAS 1.0 Variable Length Records (Sec. 2.3) -- the keyed list of typed metadata blocks between the Public Header Block and the point data.

points.name: ASPRS LAS 1.0 Point Data Records (Sec. 2.4) -- the header-length-and-count-declared array of fixed-size point records, decoded per the header's own declared Point Data Record Format (0 or 1 in LAS 1.0).
